hi.title: S.A.P.T.A
hi.decryption: Sannidhata (Treasurer), Adhyaksha (Superintendent), Pradeshika (Revenue/District), Tirthas (High Officials), Akshapatala (Audit/Record Office).

fact.en: Mistaking Mauryan 'Adhyakshas' for purely military officers; they were primarily economic and trade supervisors.
fact.hi: Mistaking Mauryan 'Adhyakshas' for purely military officers; they were primarily economic and trade supervisors.

fact.en: Assuming provincial administration was uniform; it varied significantly between the core (Magadha) and frontier provinces.
fact.hi: Assuming provincial administration was uniform; it varied significantly between the core (Magadha) and frontier provinces.

fact.en: Confusing 'Rajukas' (originally land surveyors) with later Mauryan judicial officials under Ashoka.
